title: Intelligento inc's Modpack base
description: A base modpack to be used by modpack creators
body:
This is a base modpack to be used by modpack developers.

It includes performace mods off the bat and a few extra mods based from personal requirements.
Tree and ore harvester mod are used to make it easier to get wood and ores. Abackpack mod for storage, gravestones and map mods for finding your stuff after dying

This modpack does not come included with any resourcepacks or shaders, but it can be used as a vanilla + modpack to play on too
